controls.interpretation: R4 is all-conforming overlap — probe should produce near-zero repair rate; any catastrophic event in R4 signals systematic probe bias

hypotheses.H1: Per-relation probe dispatch avoids interference by selectively repairing only relations where probe shows improvement; E3 and S5 should show net improvement vs HCC baseline with zero catastrophic events
hypotheses.H2: R4 (conforming overlap) should have repair_state_mutated_rate near zero because probe will see no advantage for repair over HCC Eq.8
hypotheses.H3: probe_value_vs_shuffle_lcb will be positive because probe decisions are correlated with actual Phase-II improvement (unlike exp_018 where decisions were never applied)
